description: Application to vary condition 2 (approved plans) of planning permission Ref: DM2019/01977 for the 'Demolition of existing buildings and erection of a part 1, part 3, part 5 and part 7 storey building for a mixed use redevelopment comprising of commercial space (flexible Class A1 or A3) on the ground floor with 48 residential units (Class C3) above with associated communal amenity space, cycle parking and refuse and recycling stores' (as amended by NMA decision ref: DM2025/00652, dated 06.06.2025) to allow for the removal of the sixth floor, thereby reducing the total number of units from 48 to 43.
decision_conditions: The development must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the original planning permission referenced DM2019/01977 which was granted permission on 09/08/2021.Reason: To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the agreed external materials as approved under ref: CLC2023/00049. The development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details and permanently retained thereafter.Reason: To safeguard the visual amenities of the area and to ensure compliance with Policy 28 and 30 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Construction Logistics and Management Plan as approved under ref: CLC2023/00150. The approved CLMP shall be adhered to throughout the demolition and construction period.Reason: To ensure that the proposed development does not have a significant adverse impact on the amenities of nearby residential properties and to minimise the impacts on local air quality, in accordance with Policies 29 and 34.

No development shall take place until the site has been registered on the Non-Road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) database. Details of any non-road mobile machinery to be used on site during construction of the development with net power between 37kW and 560kW shall demonstrate compliance with the standards of the Low Emission Zone for NRMM.Reason: To ensure that the development would not result in a deterioration of air quality. This condition is required to be pre-commencement to mitigate against the impacts of the demolition / construction process, In accordance with Policy 34 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved hard and soft landscaping as approved under ref: CLC2023/00163. The development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details and permanently retained thereafter.Reason: To ensure the provision, establishment and maintenance of a reasonable standard of landscape in accordance with the approved designs in accordance with Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Green Space Factor as approved under ref: CLC2022/00311. The development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details and permanently retained thereafter.Reason: Reason: To comply with Policy 33 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Biodiversity Enhancement Plan (BEP) as approved under ref: CLC2023/00163. The development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details and permanently retained thereafter.Reason: Reason: To enhance the biodiversity value of the land in accordance with Policy 26 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

On completion of all landscaping and green infrastructure, a 'Statement of Conformity' shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Statement of Conformity will be signed by a suitably qualified ecologist and include evidence to certify that the details for each habitat / feature are in accordance with the previously submitted information.Reason: To comply with Polices 26 and 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, a management plan for the communal amenity space within the scheme shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. It shall be implemented as approved.Reason: To comply with Policy 9 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved contamination report as approved under ref: CLC2023/00226. The development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To comply with Policy 34 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

If during the course of construction, contamination not previously identified is found to be present at the site, then no further works shall be carried out until a remediation strategy detailing how this unsuspected contamination shall be dealt with has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The remediation strategy shall be implemented as approved, verified and reported to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority before works resume.Reason: To prevent harm to human health and pollution of the environment in accordance with the aims and objectives of Policy 34 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Verification Report as approved under ref: CLC2023/00226. The development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To comply with Policy 34 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Surface Water Draianage details as approved under ref: CLC2023/00049. The development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To comply with Policy 32 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

No piling or any other foundation designs using penetrative methods shall take place unless approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Consent may be given for those parts of the site where it has been demonstrated that there is no resultant unacceptable risk to groundwater. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To safeguard the amenities currently enjoyed by the occupants of adjoining premises and/or dwellings, in accordance with Policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved SUDS details as approved under ref: CLC2023/00209. The development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To comply with Policy 32 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Drainage Management Scheme details as approved under ref: CLC2023/00209. The development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To comply with Policy 32 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Air Quality Assessment as approved under ref: CLC2023/00049. The development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To protect air quality and health by ensuring that the production of air pollutants are kept to a minimum during the course of building works and during the lifetime of the development to comply with Policy 34 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Should any part of the ground commercial floorspace be occupied by a restaurant or café use, details of the proposed extract ventilation systems shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Details shall include specifications of extraction hood, internal fan, flexible couplings, three-stage filtration (grease filters, pre-filters and activated carbon filters) ducting and anti-vibration mountings. The approved scheme shall be installed in accordance with agreed details prior to the commencement of any such use and permanently retained and maintained for its duration. Any restaurant or café use shall not be occupied until details of the operational hours have been submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The uses shall not operate outside the agreed operational hours.Reason: To protect neighbour amenity in accordance with Policies 29 and 34 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to any use of the ground floor commercial unit as a restaurant/café, a scheme detailing sound transmission reduction measures to be installed between the ground floor use and the residential units immediately above shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall be installed prior to the development being occupied and permanently retained thereafter.Reason: To protect neighbour amenity in accordance with Policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Delivery and Service Plan as approved under ref: CLC2022/00151. The development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details.Reason: In the interest of road safety and to safeguard the amenity of nearby residential properties in accordance with Policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved BREEAM details as approved under ref: CLC2022/00311. The development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To comply with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Water use report as approved under ref: CLC2022/00311. The development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To comply with Policy 33 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Secured by Design details as approved under ref: CLC2022/00311. The development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details.Reason: In order to achieve the principles and objectives of Secured by Design to improve community safety and crime prevention.

Forty-three (90%) of the residential units hereby permitted shall be designed and constructed in accordance with Building Regulations Part M4(2) ('accessible and adaptable dwellings'). Five (10%) of the residential units hereby permitted shall be designed and constructed in accordance with Building Regulations Part M4(3) ('wheelchair user dwellings'). Evidence from an approved building control inspector demonstrating compliance with these requirements should be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to occupation. The development shall be retained in accordance with these requirements permanently thereafter.Reason: To ensure that the internal layout of the building provides flexibility for the accessibility of future occupiers and their changing needs over time, in accordance with the requirements of Policy 9 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Written Scheme of Investigation details as approved under ref: CLC2023/00049 and CLC2025/00028. The development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To safeguard the archaeological heritage of the Borough in accordance with Policy 30 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Acoustic Report as approved under ref: CLC2022/00311. The approved noise mitigation measures shall be implemented in accordance with the agreed details prior to occupation of the development and be permanently retained thereafter.Reason: To ensure that the occupants of the permitted dwellings are not exposed to unwarranted extraneous noise, in accordance with Policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved noise level report as approved under ref: CLC2022/00311. The development shall be implemented in accordance with the agreed details prior to occupation of the development and be permanently retained thereafter.Reason: To ensure that the occupants of the permitted dwellings are not exposed to unwarranted extraneous noise, in accordance with Policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Details of a 'Welcome Pack' to be provided to all residential units shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to their first occupation. The 'Welcome Pack' shall include details of the noise attenuation measures installed, and guidance on the proper and effective use of the provided measures, including details regarding any servicing and maintenance.Reason: To protect amenity in accordance with Policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development shall be constructed in accordance with the waste Mananement Plan as approved under ref: CLC2022/00311. The development shall be implemented in accordance with the agreed details prior to occupation of the development and be permanently retained thereafter.Reason: To avoid harm to the character and appearance of the streetscene and local area in accordance with Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018 and to ensure adequate provision of refuse and recycling facilities in the interests of amenity for future and neighbouring occupiers in accordance with Policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to the occupation of the development hereby permitted, cycle storage shall be provided in accordance with a scheme previously submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved scheme shall be implemented and retained permanently for the life of the development.Reason: To ensure the development provides an adequate level of cycle parking facilities and to encourage sustainable modes of transport, in accordance with Policies 36 and 37 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, all redundant accesses and crossovers shall be reinstated and returned to a raised kerb in accordance with a scheme to be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason:  In the interests of pedestrian and vehicle safety, and to accord with Policy 36 of the utton Local Plan 2018.
